name: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Streaming Preview
description: Robotics endpoint optimized for real-time text streaming over the Live API, enabling low-latency robot agents with bidirectional audio and video input. Function calling uses blocking behavior for physical robot actions.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Streaming Preview model page
sources.notes: Preview model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 input / 65,536 output token limits. Function calling and Live API are supported; caching, code execution, and file search are not.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Standard tier: $0.50 input, $2.50 output, $0.05 cached input through December 31, 2026; $1.00 / $5.00 / $0.10 starting January 1, 2027.
